'''Rungs''' was a large [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]]<ref name="hs" /> and a patron at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was fond of the nightshift [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rungs first appeared in [[The Star Wars Holiday Special|''The Star Wars Holiday Special'']], a television special that aired in [[1978]]. The Rungs puppet was a repurposed prop from the [[1976]] movie, [[Wikipedia:The Food of the Gods|''The Food of the Gods'']], on which [[Rick Baker]] and [[Tom Burman]] worked. Although not initially identified by name in ''The Star Wars Holiday Special'', the [[Star Wars Blog]] article, ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who]]'' identified this Tintinna as "Rungs".<ref name="hs" />
